svg.text: MARCELLA — 1.5 L WHISKY DECANTER, SECTION A–A AND BOX FIT
Original revolve at its drawn size: outer surface kept (within 0.14 mm); glass 3.0 mm walls, 6.0 mm bottom; bar-top stopper; tray pocket re-cut so the bottle can go in.
A–A bottle on the axis, scale 1:1
bar-top, head rests on the lip
Ø26.9 synthetic cork in Ø25.9 bore
B–B bottle seated in the re-cut tray, lid closed, scale 1:1.8
Glass (light blue), whisky to the 1.5 L line (amber), wooden stopper head + cork shank, gold wire (original parts), walnut box.
